articles.summary: Diwali is a time for celebration, new beginnings, and a little extra sparkle. This year, there’s another reason to bring your futures trading game to the forefront. Diwali Gold Rush 2.0 is here on Mudrex, running from October 21 to November 11, 2026. This futures trading contest gives you two ways to earn rewards: unlock guaranteed rewards as you hit trading volume milestones, or compete for a spot among the top 10 traders on the leaderboard to win premium prizes. Two Ways to Get Rewarded 1. Hit Trading Milestones and Unlock Gold Rewards Every milestone brings you closer to your next reward. As your cumulative futures trading volume grows during the event, you can unlock rewards credited in XAUT, a gold-backed crypto asset. Here’s how the milestone rewards stack up: Cumulative Futures Trading Volume XAUT Reward (INR Equivalent) ₹2.5 crore ₹2,500 ₹5 crore ₹5,000 ₹10 crore ₹10,000 ₹50 crore ₹25,000 ₹100 crore ₹1,00,000 ₹250 crore ₹2,00,000 ₹500 crore ₹4,00,000 ₹1,000 crore ₹10,00,000 ₹2,000 crore ₹25,00,000 The best part? Your milestone rewards stack. Reach multiple milestones, and you can unlock the rewards for every milestone achieved. Once you hit a milestone, you can claim its reward directly from the event page. Across all milestones, eligible participants can earn up to ₹42.4 lakh in XAUT rewards. 2. Climb the Leaderboard for Premium Prizes Think you can make it to the top? The leaderboard adds another layer to the contest, rewarding the 10 traders with the highest cumulative eligible futures trading volume during the event. Here’s what’s up for grabs: Leaderboard Rank Prize 1 Mahindra Thar Roxx 2 KTM 85 SX 3 MacBook Pro M5 4 iPhone 17 Pro 5 Home Theatre System 6 iPad Pro 7 Apple Watch Ultra 8 DSLR Camera 9 Gaming Laptop 10 Smart TV Rankings are determined by total eligible futures trading volume across INR and USDT margin trades. If two traders have the same volume, the trader with the higher PnL ranks higher. The more eligible futures volume you accumulate, the better your chances of climbing the leaderboard. One Contest, Both INR and USDT Futures You don’t need to worry about tracking your INR and USDT margin futures trades separately. During Diwali Gold Rush 2.0, eligible trading volume from both is combined and displayed in INR. USDT-denominated trades are converted using the applicable hedge rate, making it easier to track your progress against the event milestones and leaderboard. Diwali Gold Rush 2.0: Dates to Remember Event starts: October 21, 2026, at 12:00 PM IST Event ends: November 11, 2026, at 8:00 PM IST Only eligible futures trades executed within this period count towards milestone rewards and leaderboard rankings. How to Claim Your Rewards Milestone rewards: Once you unlock a milestone, you can claim the corresponding reward from the event page. Rewards are credited in XAUT. Leaderboard prizes: Winners will be contacted by the Mudrex team after verification to coordinate prize fulfilment. All winners must complete KYC and comply with applicable Mudrex terms and platform policies. If a leaderboard winner does not respond within 48 hours of being contacted, the prize may be forfeited. Make This Diwali Count Diwali Gold Rush 2.0 brings together milestone-based gold rewards and a leaderboard packed with prizes worth competing for. Whether you’re working towards your next milestone or aiming for a place among the top 10, the contest gives you another reason to track your eligible futures trading activity on Mudrex. The Gold Rush begins October 21. Get ready to participate, track your progress, and see how far you can go. Terms & Conditions Eligibility: Participation is open to registered Mudrex users who meet the event requirements and comply with applicable Mudrex terms and policies. Eligible Trading Activity: Only valid futures trades executed within the specified event period will be considered. Trades outside this period will not count towards event rankings or reward eligibility. Trading Volume Calculation: Eligible INR and USDT margin futures trading volumes will be combined and displayed in INR. USDT-denominated volume will be converted using the applicable hedge rate. Milestone Rewards: Rewards are cumulative, and participants who achieve multiple milestones will be eligible for the rewards associated with each milestone achieved. Rewards are credited in XAUT and are subject to the applicable reward-claiming process and platform requirements. Leaderboard Rankings: Rankings are based on eligible cumulative futures trading volume during the event period. In the event of a tie, the participant with the higher PnL will rank higher. Winner Verification and Notification: Leaderboard winners are subject to verification by Mudrex. Winners must respond to Mudrex’s notification within 48 hours of being contacted, failing which their prize will be forfeited. KYC and Prize Fulfilment: Winners must complete the required KYC verification and provide any information reasonably required to verify eligibility and fulfil prizes. Prize fulfilment is subject to successful verification and compliance with applicable platform policies. Fair Participation: Mudrex reserves the right to disqualify participants involved in suspicious, abusive, fraudulent, or manipulative activity, including wash trading and multi-account abuse. Rewards may be withheld or revoked where such activity is identified. Event Modifications: Mudrex reserves the right to modify, pause, or terminate Diwali Gold Rush 2.0, subject to applicable law and platform policies. General Conditions: Participation in the event constitutes acceptance of these Terms & Conditions and the applicable Mudrex terms and policies. Mudrex may withhold or revoke rewards where participants are found to have violated these terms or the event rules. Trading Risk: Futures trading involves financial risk and may result in losses. Participation in the event does not guarantee profits or returns. Participants should assess their risk tolerance before trading.
articles.title: Diwali Gold Rush 2.0: Trade Futures, Unlock Gold Rewards, and Win Big

articles.summary: Stargate Finance (STG) is being merged into LayerZero (ZRO), and Mudrex will support this transition for eligible users. If you hold STG on Mudrex, you do not need to take any action. Eligible STG holdings will be automatically converted to ZRO based on the announced conversion ratio. Here’s everything you need to know about the merger, including the timeline, conversion ratio, and what happens to your portfolio during the transition. What Is Changing? As part of the merger, Stargate Finance (STG) will transition to LayerZero (ZRO). Mudrex will automatically convert eligible STG holdings into ZRO at the following ratio: 1 STG = 0.08634 ZRO You do not need to manually convert, transfer, or sell your STG. Mudrex will handle the conversion for eligible holdings. Key Dates to Know Event Date STG trading suspended on Mudrex 5 October 2026 STG to ZRO conversion During the merger period ZRO credited to eligible users On or before 11 October 2026 The exact timing of the conversion may vary during the merger period. What Happens If You Hold STG? If you hold eligible STG on Mudrex, your balance will be automatically converted to ZRO using the 1 STG = 0.08634 ZRO conversion ratio. During the merger period, your STG balance may temporarily not appear in your portfolio while the conversion is being processed. This does not mean that your eligible STG holdings have been lost. Rest assured, your funds are safe. Your corresponding ZRO balance will be credited to your Mudrex account on or before 11 October 2026. Example If you hold 1,000 STG, the conversion will be calculated as: 1,000 STG × 0.08634 = 86.34 ZRO The actual ZRO credited to your account will depend on your eligible STG balance at the time of the conversion. What Happens to ZRO Trading? Existing ZRO Spot trading pairs will continue to operate normally and will not be affected by the STG to ZRO merger. This means users can continue to hold and trade ZRO on Mudrex during the merge period. The merger only affects the conversion of eligible STG holdings. It does not suspend existing ZRO Spot trading. What Happens to STG Trading? STG trading on Mudrex will be suspended on 5 October 2026 as part of the merger. After the suspension, users will no longer be able to trade STG on Mudrex. Eligible STG holdings will continue through the automatic conversion process and will be credited as ZRO. What Happens to My Portfolio During the Merger? There may be a temporary period during which your STG balance does not appear in your Mudrex portfolio. This can happen while the merger and conversion are being processed. Once the conversion is completed, your eligible balance will be credited as ZRO on or before 11 October 2026. Frequently Asked Questions What is the STG to ZRO conversion ratio? The conversion ratio is: 1 STG = 0.08634 ZRO Do I need to manually convert my STG? No. Eligible STG holdings will be automatically converted to ZRO by Mudrex. When will STG trading be suspended on Mudrex? STG trading will be suspended on 5 October 2026. Will my STG balance disappear? Your STG balance may temporarily not appear in your portfolio during the merger period while the conversion is being processed. Eligible holdings will subsequently be credited as ZRO. When will I receive my ZRO? ZRO balances will be credited to eligible users on or before 11 October 2026. What if I already hold ZRO? Your existing ZRO holdings are not affected by this merger. You can continue to hold and trade ZRO on Mudrex. Do I need to sell my STG before 5 October? No. Eligible STG holdings will be automatically converted to ZRO. There is no need to manually sell or convert them.
articles.title: Stargate Finance (STG) Is Merging Into LayerZero (ZRO): What You Need to Know
